name: get_google_doc
description: Read a Google Docs document and return its plain-text content, title, revision id, and Drive metadata (created/modified times, owner, web link). Supports lookup by document_id or by name search. Body text can be truncated via max_chars.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.description: Google Docs document ID (the long alphanumeric string in the document URL). Required unless name_search is provided.

inputs.name: name_search
inputs.description: Substring to search for in document names. Returns the most recently modified match. Required unless document_id is provided.

inputs.name: include_body
inputs.description: Whether to include the document body text (default true). Set false to fetch metadata only.

inputs.name: max_chars
inputs.description: Maximum body characters to return (default 20000, max 100000). Truncation is indicated in the response.

outputs.description: The document ID used for the fetch.
Total characters in the full document body.
True if body was truncated to max_chars.
Direct URL to open the document in Google Docs.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments:
document_id: Google Docs document ID from the URL (e.g. "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgVE2upms").
name_search: Alternatively, a name substring to find the most recently modified matching doc.
include_body: true/false (default true). False returns metadata only.
max_chars: integer, default 20000, max 100000.
Note: provide document_id OR name_search, not both.
